title: Fleet Rung 29 — THE SHARE LADDER (mm-volume v1.1.0 + market-grid v1.1.0): 'the BIGGEST market maker' becomes a MEASURED number instead of a boast. The pond: market-grid now reads condenser get_volume from the chains themselves (SBD/STEEM 24h pond 163.687 SBD, HBD/HIVE 958.712 HBD) and books it into the live book + the append-only history. The share: the fleet's projected daily volume over the measured pond, as a LADDER over funded soldiers — SBD/STEEM: N=1 → 23.9286% (one soldier already holds a quarter of the venue), N=2 → 47.8572%, N=3 → 71.7858%, N=5 → 119.643% (saturates: the pond caps the capacity ladder and the tape becomes the binding — surfaced, never hidden); HBD/HIVE: 4.0855% at N=1. The truth check (Q8): realized24h meters the fill-ledger's REAL fill_order fills over a 24h window that ends at the LAST fill (deterministic from data alone) — 124 real fills measured, 62.781 SBD sold / 24.388 SBD bought, avg fill 0.703 SBD, projection accuracy 160.2865% (the projection UNDERSTATES reality: real fills run ~10× the planned notional — the assumption is now visible and can be re-based). The doctrine map (Q9): the six failures that killed the great market makers (adverse selection, inventory skew, fee drag, self-poison, silent rot, overtrading) each mapped onto the guard this fleet ships WITH the plan. Both venues' economics now flow from the live book (steem spread 1.1677% at measure time, hive 0.1645%).
